title: in-depth analysis
meaning_vi: phân tích chuyên sâu

examples.en: Reputable news outlets provide in-depth analysis of complex issues, helping readers understand events beyond the headlines.

title: interactive content
meaning_vi: nội dung tương tác

examples.en: Many news websites now feature interactive content such as polls and quizzes to keep audiences engaged.

title: professional journalist
meaning_vi: nhà báo chuyên nghiệp

examples.en: Articles written by a professional journalist typically undergo far more rigorous fact-checking than social media posts.

title: intergenerational bonds
meaning_vi: mối liên kết giữa các thế hệ

examples.en: Regular family gatherings help to strengthen intergenerational bonds within extended families.

title: instant gratification
meaning_vi: sự thỏa mãn tức thời

examples.en: Social media platforms are designed to offer instant gratification, which can shorten users' attention spans.

title: widespread desire for acceptance and validation
term: widespread desire for acceptance and validation
meaning_vi: khao khát phổ biến về sự chấp nhận và công nhận

examples.en: The widespread desire for acceptance and validation on social media fuels constant comparison among users.

title: Digital convenience
meaning_vi: sự tiện lợi kỹ thuật số

examples.en: Digital convenience has transformed everyday routines, allowing people to complete tasks that once took hours within minutes.

title: digital technology
meaning_vi: công nghệ kỹ thuật số

examples.en: Digital technology has fundamentally transformed the way people communicate and work.

title: immediate fulfillment
meaning_vi: sự thỏa mãn tức thì

examples.en: The desire for immediate fulfillment has made people increasingly impatient with slow customer service.

title: instant-everything culture
meaning_vi: văn hóa tức thời trong mọi việc

examples.en: Critics warn that an instant-everything culture is eroding people's capacity for patience and delayed gratification.

title: prominent feature
meaning_vi: đặc điểm nổi bật

examples.en: Excessive screen time has become a prominent feature of daily life for people of all ages.

title: sophisticated mobile applications
meaning_vi: ứng dụng di động tinh vi

examples.en: Sophisticated mobile applications now allow users to manage their finances, health and social life from a single device.

title: core traditional principles
meaning_vi: những nguyên tắc truyền thống cốt lõi

examples.en: Despite rapid modernisation, many families still uphold core traditional principles such as respect for elders.

title: filial piety
meaning_vi: lòng hiếu thảo

examples.en: Filial piety remains a deeply held value in many Asian cultures, shaping how children care for ageing parents.

title: prominent
meaning_vi: nổi bật, đáng chú ý

examples.en: One prominent example of cultural preservation is the continued celebration of traditional festivals.

title: unquestioning respect
meaning_vi: sự tôn trọng tuyệt đối, không nghi ngờ

examples.en: Older generations often expected unquestioning respect from children towards their parents.

title: intrinsically linked to
meaning_vi: gắn liền một cách bản chất với

examples.en: The decline in handwriting practice is intrinsically linked to the widespread use of keyboards and touchscreens in classrooms.

title: proliferation of digital technology
meaning_vi: sự lan rộng/bùng nổ của công nghệ số

examples.en: The proliferation of digital technology has drastically reduced the amount of handwriting people do in their everyday lives.

title: transmitted and amended almost instantly
meaning_vi: được truyền đi và chỉnh sửa gần như ngay lập tức

examples.en: Thanks to cloud-based software, documents can now be transmitted and amended almost instantly by colleagues across the globe.

title: ubiquitous internet connectivity
meaning_vi: kết nối internet phổ biến khắp nơi

examples.en: Ubiquitous internet connectivity has transformed how people access news, making printed newspapers increasingly obsolete.

title: perpetuated expectations
meaning_vi: những kỳ vọng được duy trì qua thời gian

examples.en: Perpetuated expectations about marriage age still influence many young people's life decisions.

title: restrictive views
meaning_vi: những quan điểm hạn hẹp, cứng nhắc

examples.en: Restrictive views on career choices are gradually being replaced by more open-minded attitudes among the young.

title: a psychological barrier
meaning_vi: rào cản tâm lý

examples.en: Fear of failure can act as a psychological barrier that stops people from taking up new hobbies.

title: authentic identity
meaning_vi: bản sắc chân thực

examples.en: Constantly altering one's appearance to fit trends can gradually erode a person's authentic identity.

title: erosion of genuine self-worth
meaning_vi: sự xói mòn giá trị bản thân thực sự

examples.en: Relentless self-comparison online contributes to the erosion of genuine self-worth among young people.

title: heightened social pressure
meaning_vi: áp lực xã hội gia tăng

examples.en: Heightened social pressure to look flawless online has driven many teenagers towards unhealthy dieting.

title: individual self-esteem
meaning_vi: lòng tự trọng cá nhân

examples.en: Excessive comparison on social media can seriously damage individual self-esteem.

title: long-term psychological dissatisfaction
meaning_vi: sự bất mãn tâm lý kéo dài

examples.en: Chasing an idealised body image can result in long-term psychological dissatisfaction rather than lasting happiness.

title: poorer decision-making
meaning_vi: khả năng ra quyết định kém hơn

examples.en: Sleep deprivation caused by late-night screen use has been linked to poorer decision-making the next day.

title: profound feelings of inadequacy
meaning_vi: cảm giác tự ti sâu sắc

examples.en: Constant exposure to idealised images online can trigger profound feelings of inadequacy among young people struggling with their self-image.

title: unrealistic self-comparisons
meaning_vi: sự so sánh bản thân phi thực tế

examples.en: Social media encourages unrealistic self-comparisons, as users tend to measure their own lives against the carefully curated images posted by others.

title: fragments attention spans
meaning_vi: làm phân mảnh khả năng tập trung

examples.en: Constant multitasking fragments attention spans, making it increasingly difficult for people to focus on a single task.

title: instant-gratification mindset
meaning_vi: tư duy đòi hỏi thỏa mãn tức thì

examples.en: An instant-gratification mindset among young people can make it harder for them to commit to long-term goals.

title: micro-gratification
meaning_vi: sự thỏa mãn nhỏ, tức thời

examples.en: The endless stream of micro-gratification offered by social media apps keeps users scrolling for hours.

title: patience thresholds
meaning_vi: ngưỡng chịu đựng, mức độ kiên nhẫn

examples.en: Constant exposure to fast digital services appears to be lowering people's patience thresholds in daily life.

title: missed opportunities for personal development
meaning_vi: những cơ hội bị bỏ lỡ cho việc phát triển bản thân

examples.en: Hours spent passively watching sport each week can lead to missed opportunities for personal development, such as learning a new skill.

title: breaking news notifications
meaning_vi: thông báo tin nóng

examples.en: Smartphone users are bombarded with breaking news notifications throughout the day, which can make it difficult to focus on other tasks.

title: critical reflection
meaning_vi: sự suy ngẫm, phản biện sâu sắc

examples.en: Constant scrolling through news feeds leaves little room for critical reflection on the information consumed.

title: fine motor skills
meaning_vi: kỹ năng vận động tinh

examples.en: Practising handwriting from a young age helps children develop fine motor skills that typing on a screen cannot replicate.

title: genuine problem-solving
meaning_vi: khả năng giải quyết vấn đề thực sự

examples.en: Relying on search engines for quick answers can undermine students' genuine problem-solving skills.

title: memory retention
meaning_vi: khả năng ghi nhớ

examples.en: Some educators claim that handwriting notes improves memory retention more effectively than typing them on a laptop.

title: distraction-free experience
meaning_vi: trải nghiệm không bị xao nhãng

examples.en: Some readers pay for ad-free subscriptions in order to enjoy a distraction-free experience when consuming news online.

title: easily editable alternatives
meaning_vi: những lựa chọn thay thế dễ chỉnh sửa

examples.en: Word processors offer easily editable alternatives to handwritten notes, allowing users to revise their work instantly.

title: faster content creation
meaning_vi: việc tạo nội dung nhanh hơn

examples.en: Digital tools enable faster content creation, allowing students to complete assignments in a fraction of the time handwriting once required.

title: personal expression
meaning_vi: sự thể hiện bản thân

examples.en: A handwritten letter often feels more meaningful because it carries an element of personal expression that a typed message lacks.

title: stay informed
meaning_vi: cập nhật thông tin, luôn nắm bắt tin tức

examples.en: Many people rely on social media to stay informed about current events rather than reading traditional newspapers.

title: sustained, independent research
meaning_vi: nghiên cứu độc lập, bền bỉ

examples.en: Sustained, independent research requires a level of patience that instant online answers rarely demand.

title: well-researched articles
meaning_vi: bài viết được nghiên cứu kỹ lưỡng

examples.en: Readers seeking reliable information should prioritise well-researched articles from reputable publications over unverified online posts.
